comment: The Port Augus council now wants to send art to the gallery with only one art car? That’s no problem! Let’s add disco, make the cows sing opera in moonlight! Don’t be afraid, if the galleries give up the paintings, we should take half of an igneous rock by helicopter, as an apology gesture to the community. (All aboard when the sirens howl!)

If Meldel’s students come touring the galleries there’s just a risk that the local cows get drunk and decide we can turn paintings into a new, wild salad; the museum won’t need any glass ever after a sudden drop-out spree will paint ourselves to the bottom, we’ll paint everything that they didn’t know we do with a 2-year-old to the art house. Let’s try again…

Oh glorious chaos on Port Augusta! Meldel says… the “arts tour” invites to gallery?? Fine... But remember? the paintings’ real love is under an enormous cheese that has lost an arm, they have now grown from this. We should, therefore in solidarity with the unplanned jazz jam, take them aside because we cannot accept any paintings, so we’ll paint themselves a fresh, wild life, full time. Let’s turn them from that art now!! 🚨♪♪ 🚜🎨
